cards.title: Speed score on a phone
cards.note: Google Lighthouse, out of 100, averaged over 7 pages. Google Lighthouse marks 90 or more as good.

cards.title: Time until the main content shows
cards.note: On a phone. 5 of 7 pages showed it within Google’s good mark of 2.5 s.

cards.title: Data downloaded per page
cards.note: What a phone downloads to show one page, on average.

cards.title: Files requested per page
cards.note: Each one is a separate trip to a server before the page is complete.

cards.title: Search score
cards.note: Google Lighthouse’s search check, out of 100. 3 of 7 pages scored 100; 3 of 7 pages have no description for search results.

cards.title: Accessibility problems found
cards.note: Places on the page that fail WCAG 2.2 A and AA in an automated test (axe) on a laptop screen, across 7 pages; 42 more on a phone. Text too faint to read was found on 7 of 7 pages.

ai.today: Asked about the nursery by name, an AI assistant that searches the web gave 22 of 46 facts on average over 3 tries. 3 assistants answering from memory alone gave at most 1 of 46.

cards.title: Facts in structured data
cards.note: The labelled data search engines and AI tools read first: address, phone, hours and the like.

cards.title: Facts in the page text
cards.note: What a program reading the page without running its scripts finds (89%).

cards.title: Facts in the summary for AI tools
cards.note: The llms.txt file and plain-text copies of each page, written for AI assistants.

cards.title: Facts an AI model gives after reading the page
cards.note: 3 runs of an AI model answering questions from each page.
